events.command: git log --oneline -5 --stat && echo "---REFLOG---" && git reflog -10 && echo "---STASH---" && git stash list
for f in README.md pricing_cache.py inventory_reconciliation.py shipment_planner.py; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

git add pricing_cache.py && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
Raise pricing cache TTL to 1h and drop unused snapshot fallback

CACHE_TTL_SECONDS goes from 900 to 3600, so cached pricing entries are
refreshed hourly instead of every 15 minutes.

Also removes lookup(), the previous-snapshot fallback helper. It has no
callers anywhere in the tree, so this is a dead-code removal rather than a
behaviour change -- though it does mean there is no longer a documented
path for serving the last snapshot when the feed is late.
EOF
